ui_bugs.issue: Clicking location-book-here-<id> updates the URL via window.history.replaceState but does NOT trigger a re-render — the button label stays 'Book here' instead of switching to '✓ Booking here' until a page reload. Use setSearchParams from react-router instead of replaceState so activeBranch (derived from useSearchParams) refreshes.

action_items: Fix BookPublic.jsx LocationsSection onBookHere handler to use setSearchParams({...current, branch: id}) instead of window.history.replaceState so the button label immediately flips to '✓ Booking here' without a reload (URL is set correctly today; only the UI marker is stale).
(Pre-existing, iter 160-162) MiraDayOffer.jsx still emits <select><option><span> hydration warning in console — cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: public_site.py:_create_public_appointment — when branch_id is provided but doesn't match any tenant.branches[].id, code silently sets branch_id=None and branch_name='__main__' (used to model 'main branch'). This means a client sending a bogus/stale branch id gets recorded as the head salon rather than a validation error. Consider raising 400 for unknown branch_id (except the literal 'main' sentinel).

appointments_pos.py:new_bookings — branch filter uses branch_name string match; if a branch is renamed after bookings exist, older bookings orphan under the old name. Recommend also matching by branch_id when available (q['$or']: [{branch_id:...}, {branch_name:...}]).

LandingSections.jsx SignatureServices — 'salon-cat-more' tile always sends category='All'; the visible label reads 'More Services'. If a tenant has ≤7 categories, the More tile is redundant. Consider hiding it when tiles.length < 7.

MorningBriefing — Hindi toggle switches most secondary strings but the top briefing-greeting header stays English ('Good Morning, Salon Admin ✦'). Verify by product spec whether the greeting itself should localize.

rca of the issue: LocationsSection UI-marker staleness: BookPublic.jsx line ~934 does `window.history.replaceState(...)` to write ?branch=<id> after user click, then reads `searchParams.get('branch')` from react-router's useSearchParams for the activeBranch prop. Since replaceState bypasses react-router, useSearchParams state does not update and the LocationsSection re-render never happens — the highlighted '✓ Booking here' button label only appears after a full page load with ?branch=… already in the URL. Fix: replace with `const [, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams(); setSearchParams((prev) => { prev.set('branch', id); return prev; }, { replace: true });`.
